gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and lets its s and z stand full and generous on the line. Capture It is the blunter one, a single unbroken stroke built for impact, while the body font handles the quiet work.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-anato: Capture It draws every letter at a flat, marker-like weight, with openings so slight the shapes nearly seal shut. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs goes the other way, pointing its terminals outward and rising close to cap height.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-arabi: Noto Sans Arabic opens its small letters wide and carries a pronounced x-height, which gives text a clear, modern look. Capture It stays tight and closed up, like marker lines.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-armen: Urban and blunt, Capture It draws even its g with one unchanging line weight and almost no gaps. Noto Sans Armenian softens things with full, rounded c, s and z and wide, inviting curves.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-balin: Dense, shouting letters with barely a gap in them lead the way, set in Capture It's towering lowercase. Noto Sans Balinese gives every curve breathing space and keeps its ascenders short, so lines glide along.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-benga: Noto Sans Bengali reads with distinctly open letter mouths, and its capitals sit close to the lowercase height, so text looks level and unfussy. Capture It, by contrast, packs in the tight, sealed shapes of an urban sign.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-bugin: Capture It hits hard, with a towering lowercase and nearly sealed letters. Noto Sans Buginese leaves its mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs and keeps its ascenders short, so it can sit at a modest size without crowding.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-caria: A flat, constant line weight hums through every Capture It letter, with openings pinched almost shut. Noto Sans Carian lets its terminals stay apart like open scissor blades, giving the text room to breathe beneath.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-cham: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Cham opens its c shapes with plenty of entry space and rounds out its lowercase forms. Capture It is the heavy hitter here, with bowls whose walls never swell.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-chero: Noto Sans Cherokee reads in a high band of lowercase with short stalks above and an e left wide open at its terminal. Capture It is the opposite, a sealed, zero-modulation shout that makes a firm headline.
